SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, P.INTRO, P.RESIDENCE, P.MBTI, P.GENDER, M.REL_INTENT_ID, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, NVL(MP.PHOTO_URL, '/images/default-profile.png') AS PHOTO_URL, ROUND(6371 * ACOS( COS(TRUNC(NVL(#{latitude}, 37.5665), 7) * 0.0174532925) * COS(TRUNC(M.LATITUDE, 7) * 0.0174532925) * COS((TRUNC(M.LONGITUDE, 7) * 0.0174532925) - (TRUNC(NVL(#{longitude}, 126.9780), 7) * 0.0174532925)) + SIN(TRUNC(NVL(#{latitude}, 37.5665), 7) * 0.0174532925) * SIN(TRUNC(M.LATITUDE, 7) * 0.0174532925) ), 1) AS DISTANCE FROM "MEMBER" M JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON (M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER_PHOTOS" MP ON (M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO AND MP.PHOTO_ORDER = 1) WHERE M.DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'Y' AND M.MEMBER_NO != #{memberNo}
AND ( P.GENDER = #{gender} OR P.GENDER = CASE WHEN #{gender} = '남성' THEN 'M' WHEN #{gender} = '여성' THEN 'F' ELSE #{gender} END )
AND P.GENDER = (SELECT TARGET_GENDER FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo})
AND FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) BETWEEN
#{minAge} 0
AND
#{maxAge} 120
) WHERE (
DISTANCE <= #{distance} DISTANCE <= 100
OR DISTANCE IS NULL ) ORDER BY DISTANCE ASC

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, P.INTRO, P.RESIDENCE, P.MBTI, P.GENDER, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, MP.PHOTO_URL, C.CODE_NAME AS REL_INTENT_NAME FROM "MEMBER" M JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON (M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER_PHOTOS" MP ON (M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MASTER_CODES" C ON (M.REL_INTENT_ID = C.CODE_ID) WHERE M.MEMBER_NO = #{targetNo} ORDER BY MP.PHOTO_ORDER ASC

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, P.INTRO, P.RESIDENCE, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, MP.PHOTO_URL FROM "MEMBER_ACTION" A JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (A.SENDER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON (M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER_PHOTOS" MP ON (M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO) WHERE A.RECEIVER_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.ACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE' AND MP.PHOTO_ORDER = 1

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, P.INTRO, P.RESIDENCE, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, MP.PHOTO_URL FROM "MEMBER_ACTION" A JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (A.RECEIVER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON (M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER_PHOTOS" MP ON (M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO) WHERE A.SENDER_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.ACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE' AND MP.PHOTO_ORDER = 1
